hooks.name: Auto commit
hooks.description: Stages safe changed files and creates a local commit with a generated message. Never pushes.

action.prompt:
If there are uncommitted changes (check `git status --porcelain`), create a local commit:
1. Review `git status` and `git diff` to understand the changes.
2. Stage files by explicit path (never `git add -A`, `git add .` or `git add -f`). Skip anything ignored by .gitignore, and skip sensitive files: .env and .env.* (except .env.example), keys, certificates, credentials, tokens, secrets, and anything containing secret values. If a file looks sensitive but is not gitignored, do not stage it and tell the user.
3. Write a Conventional Commits title: `type(scope): summary`. type is one of feat, fix, docs, style, refactor, perf, test, build, ci, chore. scope is the component or area changed (e.g. clippy, terminal, server, hooks), omitted only if the change spans the whole repo. Use imperative mood, lowercase summary, 72 characters or fewer total. Add a short body (1-3 lines or bullets) explaining what and why, and mention the updated component(s).
4. Run `git commit` with that message.
5. NEVER run `git push`. The user will review and push manually.
If nothing is safe to commit, do nothing and say so in one line. Finish with the commit hash and title.
